bedrockreloaded.general_text:
I don't know where and what would be the best way to say: thank you to all those people who contributed or helped me in some way with this modpack.

So thank you, you who are reading this, this modpack took months and even many years to make. And without these people, none of this would be possible:
bedrockreloaded.connect.tooltip:
Bedrock Edition server support is currently in beta. Some features may not function correctly.

To use this feature, you must sign in with a Bedrock account. Click this button, then select "Account for Bedrock Edition".
bedrockreloaded.realms: Minecraft Realms is not officially supported. Since Realms does not allow custom mods, several modpack features will be unavailable or may not function as intended.
